body: https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal/blob/v1_60/encoder/basisu_enc.cpp is also different from ours and the difference is not in the patches at all. Might be others. Perhaps best to start with a fresh copy of everything from basis universal?

+               // By default the encoder assumes the input is in absolute luminance (in nits or candela per square meter, cd/m<B2>), specified as positive-only linear light RGB, using the REC 709 colorspace gamut (but NOT the sRGB transfer function, i.e. linear light).
                // If the m_rec2020_bt2100_color_gamut flag is true, the input colorspace is treated as REC 2020/BT.2100 (which is wider than 709).
                // For SDR/LDR->HDR upconversion, the REC 709 sRGB input should be converted to linear light (sRGB->linear) and the resulting normalized linear RGB values scaled by either 80 or 100 nits (the luminance of a typical SDR monitor). 
                // SDR upconversion to normalized [0,1] (i.e. non-absolute) luminances may work but is not supported because ITP errors will not be predicted correctly.
